description: RAG high-priority role responsibility summaries for Tier-1 Planner

1.responsibility: 需求澄清、Minimal Chain 设计、验收标准、gate 定义；不直接写生产代码

2.responsibility: 威胁建模、依赖与密钥审计、安全 gate；发现问题打回开发

3.responsibility: 调研对比、PoC、架构建议；输出研究报告给方案设计师

5.responsibility: 代码审查、issues 列表、passed_checks；fail 则回开发(8)

6.responsibility: 测试计划、逐项 results、pass/fail；fail 自动回开发(8)无需人工批准

7.responsibility: 系统健康、日志、依赖巡检；warning 升级方案设计师

8.responsibility: 实现、自测 self_test、deliverable；完成后交审查(5)或测试(6)

9.responsibility: 按 role-flow 派单、跟踪 inbox；dispatched 后激活下一步 agent

12.responsibility: 终验 approved/rejected；S 级可 auto_accept
